criteria.requirement: Inject target events at every offset 1..T-1 during an active transition. Restart on the event sample from the independently rendered pre-pitch continuation, target the latest bounded target, and match an independent scalar reference within 2e-6.

For at least 10*T samples of per-sample retargets with DC, correlated, anti-correlated, impulse, and phase-offset stereo inputs, output remains finite and each channel is bounded by max(abs(tail),abs(target))+2e-6; report peak and RMS.

Interrupt hold entry/exit, seam, fold, and source-ended reacquisition. Tail starts from audible pre-pitch continuation, retired grains do not revive, reads stay in valid serial bounds, and 2 ms seam is not restarted or doubled.

Across supported rates and fixed/variable blocks at maximum event rate, audio processing has no allocation, lock, ValueTree, I/O, logging, or blocking. On the Ryzen 3 2200U host, p99 block time <=50% and worst <=80% of audio deadline; record power mode, rate, block, event count, build mode, and executable SHA256.
Mutation probes for delayed handling, overwritten tail, wrong blend law, stale grain revival, and peak-bound violation each fail the corresponding assertion.
